checks.rule: Application land must be clearly identifiable on OS mapping
Transfers/leases of part normally require a plan
Approved estate-plan references must use the current approved version
Estate plan must clearly show scale and orientation
Preferred developing-estate scale is 1:500; 1:1250 may suffice where detail is clear
Do-not-scale or identification-only plans are not acceptable for estate approval
Surveyed-plan accuracy gate is 0.3mm at map scale plus 1:1000 of measured distance
Survey control and as-built work should retain the original survey datum
Measurements shown on estate plans must be metric
External site detail sufficient to relate development to registered-title boundaries is required
Separate parcels such as garage/parking should be individually distinguished
PDF print scaling can invalidate stated scale and must be controlled
